text:
maria: Heads-up — Q3 retail promo forecast changed; expected GPU-hours +24% week of Nov 20. Need packing plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jordan: can you paste numbers? is this global or just us-east?
maria: it's global but APAC spike predicted in early morning PST. Here's quick extract:
```text
week_start: 2024-11-20
expected_gpu_hours: 120k (+24%)
95th_p99_latency_target: 150ms
peak_window: 03:00-06:00 UTC (APAC)
```
raj: major concern = fragmentation on 8xA100 nodes. small jobs + long-lived KV cache seat leads to holes.
sophie: agree. We saw 18% increase in unusable GPUs last promo due to non-consolidated long-running evals.
ops-bot: alert created: "promo-2024-provision" assigned to @maria @raj
jordan: propose short-term: preemptible packing + aggressive defrag window during off-peak. Long-term: slot-based scheduling with soft affinity.
maria: noted. numbers: if we defrag 4h/night we reclaim ~7-9% usable capacity. To cover 24% we still need ~15% extra reserved or better packing.
raj: thinking of a hybrid: prioritize small latency-sensitive jobs on soffit nodes, colocate big batch on fractional packing with QP quantization profile.
sophie: can we run a canary: enable `binpack_strict=true` on one rack and measure eviction rate for 48h?
jordan: yes. I'll spin up config change PR and a canary job. PR will include metric dashboard:
- fragmentation_ratio
- reclaimable_gpu_hours
- preemption_count
- p95_latency_by_tier
maria: also need cost calc. If we reserve extra dedicated capacity it's ~$28k/month for needed GPU hours; vs preemptible on-demand burst ~ $9k incremental but with higher p99 risk.
capacity-bot: forecast model v2 updated — new 95% CI includes APAC promo tail, probability of >20% spike = 0.36
raj: action items:
- jordan: canary config + dashboard (48h) — due EOD tomorrow
- sophie: run offline binpack sim with current job mix — due in 48h
- maria: procurement decision if canary shows <5% latency regression — due Mon
jordan: starting PR now. tagging infra-oncall for thunderdome if preemptions spike.
sophie: small note: network egress in APAC constrained last time; might need placement override to avoid single AZ saturation.
maria: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
ops-bot: reminder set for 2024-11-18 10:00 PT for thread participants.
jordan: quick command I'll run:
```bash
# simulate packing
python tools/binpack_sim.py --jobs jobs_telemetry.q3 --nodes 500 --quantize
```
maria: LGTM. keep it tight.
